triggers.name: new_events
triggers.title: New events
triggers.description: Triggers when a new event is created in Okta secondary
triggers.help: Retrieves all the Okta system log events of a specific category, type and outcome that have occured from a given starting date and time.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Specifies from which date and time to begin searching for Okta system logs of the chosen event type and result. Date range should not be more than 180 days. Leave empty to get events since an hour ago…

input.name: eventcategory
input.label: Event category
input.hint: Specify the category of events that you wish to receive from Okta. If Other events is selected, please provide the event types in the Other event types field.

input.name: event_type
input.label: Event types
input.hint: Specify the events that you wish to receive from Okta. Either Event types or Other event types need to be provided.

input.name: event_type
input.label: Event type name (Deprecated)
input.hint: Full event type name. See API docs for full list of event types.

input.name: result_type
input.label: Event result
input.hint: Specifies whether you need a positive or negative outcome for the chosen event

triggers.name: scheduled_new_events
triggers.title: Scheduled event search using filter
triggers.description: Scheduled event search using filter in Okta secondary
triggers.help: Executes search for Okta system log events on a specified schedule. Events can be filtered and will be returned in batches. Each batch is processed as individual jobs. Batch size is between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Okta system log events that occur after this date and time will be returned for each scheduled search. At the time of each scheduled search, only events that occur less than 180 days ago will be picke…

input.name: hour
input.label: Hour
input.hint: Hours in 24-hour format, i.e. 11 for 11am, 23 for 11pm. Defaults to 00 (12am) if left empty.

input.name: minute
input.label: Minute
input.hint: Minutes past the hour, i.e 00 for 0 minutes.

input.name: day_of_month
input.label: Day of month
input.hint: 1 - 31 , will be rounded down to last day of month for shorter months. Defaults to first day of the month if left empty.

input.name: query
input.label: Filter
input.hint: Learn more about filters here .

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Minimum is 1, maximum is 1000. Default is 100.
